name: Create an encrypted local case
what_must_be_demonstrated: A case directory exists with a plaintext header and a database that is not a readable SQLite file; the recovery key is returned exactly once
notes: Byte-level check that case.db does not begin with the SQLite magic header. The recovery key is asserted non-empty and never re-read - there is no command that returns it again (D-026).

name: Ingest one URL preserving its source
what_must_be_demonstrated: A source row with raw and canonical locators, and a capture carrying the connector, job, completeness and from_fixture flag
notes: No command exposes ingest_url: src-tauri takes no kokin-net dependency and there is no live transport (increment 17 limitation 2). Closing this gap is increment 26.

name: Preserve integrity metadata
what_must_be_demonstrated: The stored content hash recomputes from the collected bytes
notes: Checked by rehashing the fixture and comparing against Ingested.content_hash, rather than trusting the value the pipeline reported about itself.

name: Extract normalised observations
what_must_be_demonstrated: Observations exist and each carries a locator_json that is neither empty nor an empty object
notes: A value with no locator cannot be traced back into the document, which makes the lineage panel unbuildable.

name: Create candidate entities and a relationship
what_must_be_demonstrated: Two entities of different types and one relationship between them, each grounded in the observation
notes: Entity types come from the seeded registry: person and organisation. The type list is data, not schema (ADR-0006).

name: The relationship opens its supporting evidence
what_must_be_demonstrated: evidence_for on the relationship returns the observation it was created from, and that observation's document is still readable
notes: The command layer has no relationship read (increment 16 limitation 6). The ungrounded state is additionally unreachable: a trigger refuses deletion of the last evidence for a row that still exists.

name: A person accepts it
what_must_be_demonstrated: review_status = accepted and relationship_confidence recorded, with an audit_event naming user:local
notes: review_status.accepted is machine_assignable: false and its definition requires an audit event, so the test asserts the chain names the actor rather than only that the value was stored.

name: Search the case and review its history
what_must_be_demonstrated: A query returns hits, coverage travels with them, and the audit chain verifies Intact
notes: Coverage is not an Option and there is no command returning hits without it (D-029).

name: Close and reopen with no data loss
what_must_be_demonstrated: Observation, entity, relationship and evidence_link counts are identical across a close and reopen, and an id held from before still reads
notes: The entity read after reopening also asserts all seven confidence dimensions are present (D-031).

name: Export and restore
what_must_be_demonstrated: package writes a file, verify returns Ok with no passphrase, import produces a case that opens and still holds the entity and its evidence
notes: kokin-export has no command layer (increment 18 limitation 4). Verify is deliberately called without a passphrase - integrity must be checkable by someone who cannot open the case.

name: Repeat the whole sequence offline from fixtures
what_must_be_demonstrated: Steps 1-10 run a second time into a fresh directory and produce an identical summary, with every request served from a fixture
notes: Under ReplayHttp a cache miss is an error, so passing this is what establishes steps 2-10 never touched the network. Verified by an A/B: storing the fixture under a different request produces FixtureMissing naming the method, URL and key.
